title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Sound Effects and the Arena

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】効果音とか闘技場とか
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] Sound Effects and the Arena

blocks.source: ダメージ時にバシッという効果音＆点滅処理を付けてみました。Labyrinth Starでは何となくやらなかったのですが、また雰囲気が変わって良いかと思います。目立たない部分ながらも、気持ちの良い効果音は重要です。スクショの意味があんまり無いというツッコミは無しで。どうでもいいけど、カマドウマのモンスターっぽさは異常。
blocks.translation: I added a sharp sound effect and a flashing effect when damage is taken. I somehow didn't do this in Labyrinth Star, but I think it gives the game a nice change of atmosphere. Even though they are subtle details, pleasant sound effects are important. And no comments about how the screenshot doesn't really mean anything. On an unrelated note, the monster-like quality of the camel cricket is absurd.

blocks.source: 闘技場を作ってみました。相変わらずのベタなストーリーを突き進んでいます。余裕があればイベント終了後も施設として使えるようにしたいところですが・・・。
blocks.translation: I made an arena. I'm continuing to push ahead with the same old cliché story. If I have the time, I'd like to make the arena usable as a facility even after the event ends, but....

blocks.source: 最終的には町やダンジョンといった地点の数が合計で50程度になる予定です。現状メインストーリーだけに関しては、マップ：80%、イベント：76%まで一応は完成しています。町やダンジョンまたはそのイベントのいずれかが１つ完成すれば丁度+2%なので分かりやすいです。ただし、サブイベントは除いていますし、町人の配置などは無視した数値です。戦闘関連もロクに手を付けていません。
blocks.translation: In the end, there are planned to be around 50 locations in total, such as towns and dungeons. As far as the main story is concerned, the maps are nominally 80% complete and the events 76% complete. Since completing one town, dungeon, or related event adds exactly 2%, it's easy to understand. However, side events are excluded, and the figure ignores things like placing townspeople. I haven't properly started on the battle-related aspects either.

blocks.source: 一週間に2%を目標に、今年中には最初から最後までストーリーが繋がるようにはしたいですが、そこからまた長々と調整を加えるかと思います。「このキャラの登場イベントはインパクトが弱いな」とか、「ここの会話は面白くないな」とか、「このダンジョンはもっと個性が欲しいな」とか、直したいところはいっぱいありますゆえ。
blocks.translation: My goal is 2% per week, and I'd like to have the story connected from beginning to end by the end of this year, but I expect I'll spend a long time making further adjustments after that. There are plenty of things I want to fix, such as, “This character's introductory event lacks impact,” “This conversation isn't interesting,” and “This dungeon needs more individuality.”

blocks.source: 正直、あまりの作業量に「いつまで経っても終わりが見えない」と思っていましたが、何だかんだ言ってかなりの所まで来ました。脱ニートして時間が減ったのは残念ですが、以前の勤め先で精神的にヤバ気で制作もままならぬ頃を思えば、マシと言えなくもないです。生活リズムが安定したせいか土日の集中力もぼちぼちです。
blocks.translation: To be honest, the sheer amount of work had me thinking, “I'll never see the end of this,” but somehow I've made it quite far. It's a shame that I have less time now that I've stopped being a NEET, but compared to when I was mentally falling apart at my previous job and could barely work on this project, I can't say things aren't better. Perhaps because my daily routine has stabilized, my concentration on weekends is reasonably decent too.

blocks.source: でもって、RPG制作講座のネタ切れが徐々に近付いて来た気がするので、残りのネタを書きだしてみます。ただし、一部は単体で記事にする程の量にはならないかもしれません。
blocks.translation: Also, I feel like I'm gradually running out of topics for the RPG Design Guides, so I'll write down the remaining ones. However, some of them may not be substantial enough to make into articles on their own.

blocks.source: これだけ書けば、当初想定した内容は網羅できた事になるので、とりあえずは講座完成としても良いかと思います。量的にも本一冊近くにはなったはずです。まだまだ未熟者ゆえ、やっぱりここは違うだろというのは出てくる可能性もありますが、今の自分としてはこんなところでしょう。
blocks.translation: Writing all this would cover everything I originally planned to discuss, so I think it would be fine to consider the guides complete for now. In terms of volume, it should be nearly enough for a whole book. I'm still inexperienced, so I may come across things that make me think, “No, this part is wrong after all,” but this is probably about as far as I can go at present.

blocks.source: その後も・・・
blocks.translation: After that....

blocks.source: ドット絵、作曲などに分野を広げる。
blocks.translation: Expand into fields such as pixel art and music composition.

blocks.source: 特定の市販RPGを分析したり、改善案を出してみる。
blocks.translation: Analyze specific commercial RPGs and propose improvements.

blocks.source: あるテーマを元に多数の市販RPGを統計的に分析してみる。
blocks.translation: Statistically analyze a large number of commercial RPGs based on a particular theme.

blocks.source: という具合にネタは作れそうですが、しばらく充電が必要やもしれません。RPGレビューも１０年以上やってないゲームを記憶だけで書くのは難しいものがあるので同じく詰まる可能性大です。
blocks.translation: I could probably come up with topics along those lines, but I may need to recharge for a while. RPG reviews may also become difficult, since writing about games I haven't played in over ten years based solely on memory is no easy task, so there's a good chance I'll get stuck there too.

blocks.source: ていうか、働き出すとクリアに50時間とか掛かるような市販ゲームをやろうという気持ちがさっぱり起こらんとです・・・。小説なら10冊読める、アニメなら120話見れると考えると、どんだけ時間掛かるんよという感じです。絶対、この辺が近頃ゲーム（特に長編RPG）が売れない原因だと思ってます。
blocks.translation: Actually, once you start working, you completely lose the desire to play commercial games that take 50 hours to clear.... When you think that you could read 10 novels or watch 120 anime episodes in that time, you can't help but wonder how long it takes. I'm absolutely convinced that this is one of the reasons games, especially long-form RPGs, haven't been selling well lately.

blocks.source: この作品は目標30時間規模ですが、グダグダ引き伸ばすのではなく、やりたい事を盛り込んだ結果の自然なプレイ時間となる事を心掛けたいところです。
blocks.translation: This project is intended to be around 30 hours long, but rather than dragging it out aimlessly, I want to make sure the playtime naturally reaches that length as a result of including everything I want to do.
